dedupe_keys.name: are mauritania telecommunications market observatory mobile fixed internet

description: The Autorité de Régulation of Mauritania regulates telecommunications, electricity, water and post, and keeps an observatory for each sector. The telecommunications observatory page links three PDF documents: the mobile telephony market, the fixed telephony market and the internet market. These give subscriber numbers, penetration and operator market shares for Mauritel, Mattel and Chinguitel. The page also links a quality of service section. Coverage: Mauritania, national totals by period and operator. Format and access: PDF files on the ARE website, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: the PDFs are overwritten in place at the same address, so older periods are not kept; the period covered was not checked; PDF only. Simulation uses: current subscriber and market share figures for Mauritanian telecom demand models and resilience studies. Related records: data-itu-ict-statistics gives national series over time; data-opencellid gives crowdsourced cell positions for Mauritania.
licence: not stated (no licence or terms statement on the provider pages read on 2026-09-28)
